                                                                                                                                              TPS3808
                                                                                                          SBVS050N – MAY 2004 – REVISED AUGUST 2026

            TPS3808 Low-Quiescent-Current, Programmable-Delay Supervisory Circuit
1 Features                                                                3 Description
•    Power-on reset generator with adjustable delay                       The TPS3808 family of microprocessor supervisory
     time: 1.25ms to 10s                                                  circuits monitors system voltages from 0.4V to 5V,
•    Very low quiescent current: 2.4μA typical                            asserting an open-drain RESET signal when the
•    High threshold accuracy: 0.5% typical                                SENSE voltage drops below a preset threshold
•    Fixed threshold voltages for standard voltage rails                  or when the manual reset (MR) pin drops to a
     from 0.9V to 5V and adjustable voltage down to                       logic low. The RESET output remains low for the
     0.4V are available                                                   user-adjustable delay time after the SENSE voltage
•    Manual reset (MR) input                                              and manual reset (MR) return above the respective
•    Open-drain RESET output                                              thresholds.
•    Temperature range: –40°C to 125°C
                                                                          The TPS3808 device uses a precision reference to
•    Small SOT-23 and 2mm × 2mm WSON packages
                                                                          achieve 0.5% threshold accuracy for VIT ≤ 3.3V. The
2 Applications                                                            reset delay time can be set to 20ms by disconnecting
                                                                          the CT pin, 300ms by connecting the CT pin to
•    DSP or microcontroller applications                                  VDD using a resistor, or can be user-adjusted from
•    Notebook and desktop computers                                       1.25ms to 10s by connecting the CT pin to an external
•    PDAs and handheld products                                           capacitor. The TPS3808 device has a very low typical
•    Portable and battery-powered products                                quiescent current of 2.4μA, so it is an excellent
•    FPGA and ASIC applications                                           choice for battery-powered applications. TPS3808 is
                                                                          available in the SOT-23 and 2mm × 2mm WSON
                                                                          packages, and is fully specified over a temperature
                                                                          range from –40°C to 125°C (TJ).
